title: Faken (Veggie Bacon)
description: This marinated smoked tofu fries up into crisp veggie bacon! Freezing the tofu and thawing helps to improve the texture, and makes it easier to slice.
ingredients: 1 (7.5 ounce) package smoked firm tofu, frozen and thawed

steps.text: Slice the thawed tofu into very thin slices (like bacon). In a medium bowl, stir together the yeast, water, maple syrup, liquid smoke, soy sauce, onion powder and garlic powder. Place the tofu strips into the bowl to marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat butter or margarine in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Quickly fry tofu strips until crisp, turning once, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels, and serve immediately.

video.description: This video shows you how to make your own veggie bacon. A simple marinade turns slices of smoked firm tofu into crispy, flavorful fakin’ bacon. Fry them up in a little vegetable oil or butter. And enjoy on a BLT, crumbled over an omelet, or chopped and added to salads. In the video, you’ll discover the trick to getting excellent texture from the tofu.
